notes.note: She taught special education, and her capstone designs for people with motor disabilities. Voiceitt, which builds speech technology for people with disabilities, hired her as its only designer.

notes.note: A quote from a potential user who uses a wheelchair, near the top of the case study. 4 of the 10 used someone else's voice, and 2 of them put it inside a case study.

notes.note: 5 in-person interviews with wheelchair users. Every readable case study in the set showed research or testing with real participants.
